items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Your big E slept off the bridge / [INTERVIEWEE] That's mine too All mine, that is

ctx.x: Oh, that was, oh let me see. I was about, let's see, that piece must be about 50, let's see. Oh, I was about, let's see. I was about, I was about 20, I was in some way in my, that's over 40 years ago, 40 years ago, that's over 40 years ago, around 50 years ago, not up in there. I was calling him a boy. I was sitting down one day, in Red Light District, just sitting down playing that melody. I was sitting down playing that melody, not knowing what I was playing. See? And he walked in and he says, gee what's that…
You got a killer? You got a killer? Your big E slept off the bridge
That's mine too All mine, that is Nobody mix up in that number That's all me, that is For years and years that's been all mine
